topic: What time does the last train from Glasgow Central to Edinburgh leave on a Saturday?

text: @claude what time's the last train from glasgow central to edinburgh on a saturday? trying to work out if we can do sat night in edi and still get home

I couldn't confirm the current Saturday last-train times. One ScotRail listing shows a last Edinburgh Waverley to Glasgow Central train at 23:45, but it was undated. Another report mentioned a much earlier cut during disruption. Please check the live times before you book. The journey planner at scotrail.co.uk/train-times/edinburgh-waverley-to-glasgow-central should have them.
